notes: This source is a navigational index of Federal Reserve Operating Circulars (OC 1–12) with one-line descriptions; it is not itself a diagnostic, defect-register, or reform-mapping document. Only the OC 10 (Lending) entry falls within the ratified scope, as it identifies the instrument establishing discount-window Advances, Obligations, and Collateral-pledging terms — relevant as raw evidentiary material for the fragmentation/interoperability diagnostic between Federal Reserve discount-window and FHLB collateral rules. The source contains no content on discount-window stigma, FHLB collateral/operational rules, Call Report or FR 2052a reporting timing/granularity, a defect register, or the Hsu/McKernan reform proposals; those topics are therefore not represented in this extraction. Other Operating Circulars (OC 1–9, OC 12) are outside the ratified scope and were excluded. Terms 'Advances,' 'Obligations,' and 'Collateral' appear capitalized in the source (suggesting they are defined terms within OC 10 itself) but are not defined within this index text, so they are recorded per the FIDELITY RULE as '(undefined here)' rather than harmonized with any external definition.
